emails.body:
Hello Bakker & Zoon,

I run a 3-location office vending network in Amsterdam Zuid and want a reliable weekly food supplier. Your pricing is attractive, but the 6-day lead time on my last order is too slow for fresh stock.

Please confirm your best terms. Happy to commit to regular volume.
